study: G4 E6 matched G1 feature and loss ablation
primary_endpoint: macro Dice over the 184 validation tumor images
secondary_endpoints: candidate oracle Dice and selector regret on the common 320 grid
image-label AUROC, AUPRC, F1, MCC, Brier score, NLL and ECE

data_boundary.training_inputs: 2981 canonical train images, binary image labels, and frozen rich-gallery candidates
data_boundary.choice_freezing: 371 validation candidate choices are frozen before any polygon is opened
data_boundary.spatial_evaluation: a separate process opens exactly 184 validation polygons

shared_configuration.encoder: frozen RAD-DINO; layers 4, 8 and 12 projected from 768 to 128 dimensions
shared_configuration.scorer: LayerNorm-MLP with unchanged 1156-dimensional input and parameter count in every arm

capacity_control: Removed feature blocks are set to zero; tensor width and scorer parameters are not changed.
compute_control: The image encoder and descriptor cache run once; seven unique models per seed produce eight reported arms because feature-full and loss-full are the same trained model.
selection: Every learned G1 logit is fused with the same frozen upstream score by the fixed 0.5/0.5 average percentile-rank rule.

statistics.primary_contrasts: each cumulative arm against its immediate predecessor
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction within the feature family and within the loss family

published_principles: negative-bag instances are negative under the standard multiple-instance-learning assumption
smooth LogSumExp is a differentiable approximation to max pooling
